status: readiness privacy, reviewed-source and complete-score component verified in local source scope
completed: The shared signed-in readiness endpoint reads reviewed sections through the existing caller-bound summary projection, not documents or raw document_extractions SELECTs. No service/raw fallback exists.
Only the newest planning document can provide reviewed sections; a pending newer document does not cause an older summary to be substituted. Missing or malformed projection receipts stop generation.

Current canonical student reading proof and Partner-only exclusion are required before source collection, before the provider request and before returning a result. Owner/admin management status is not accepted as student access.

Exact selected document/review versions and bounded metadata are revalidated before the provider request and before returning its result. Removed, superseded, changed or newly unreviewed sources are refused; there is no automatic generation retry.

Every readiness-score page has an exact count and unique validated student/row identities. Later-page failure, changed count, duplicate pages, foreign rows and malformed records fail closed. A duplicate beyond the first REST page cannot support a falsely unambiguous score.
Invalid numeric values are not promoted to assessed scores. Existing deterministic score/status grounding and account/student session safeguards remain covered.
Goal, voice and document inputs are labelled as recent bounded samples, not complete histories; document types use readable labels. Public demos stay fictional and do not invoke private generation.
limits: Fresh authorization and document checks are separate requests; this does not establish transaction-held provider authority or cancel/retract a request already received by an external provider.

Profile, goals, scores, voice and Builder reads are not certified as one atomic cross-table snapshot. Paging validates counts and row identities, not a global database snapshot under all concurrent edits.
The reviewed-only projection is an existing unpromoted schema prerequisite. Deploying application source alone is not an approved rollout.
Shared endpoint/session source coverage does not certify exact-release all-role/demo/mobile behavior on hosted staging or production.
